messages:
sana: deploybot just created a soft-pin for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1 due to KV-state drift on long sessions. thinking we should coordinate fallback + triage.
deploybot: ACTION: soft-pin applied -> model 'quant-v5b' prefers runtime 2.17 in ap-southeast-1. TTL: 12h. pin_id=pin_4445560001. reason: kvcache sequence drift observed.
priya: is this the same eviction misalign we saw last week or a new regression? any repro yet?
mike: logs look slightly different (off-by-16 instead of off-by-2). snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T19:02:11Z] node-34 kernelA: kvcache evict idx mismatch shard=3 expected=8192 got=8176
[2026-03-23T19:02:11Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum != stored_checksum
```
eng-runtime: assigning eng-runtime to investigate. hypothesis: async eviction + quant kernel A race when sequence windows cross 4096 boundary. will add pairing traces to harness.
product: heads-up: if this persists >24h we need a short customer FYI blurb. @support please standby for canned replies.
sre-oncall: routing new sessions to f32-fallback will increase 95p by ~50-100ms and CPU cost. I'll add alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >0.8% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >200ms -> pager.
sana: proposal: 1) extend soft-pin to 24h to buy triage time 2) route new sessions to f32 fallback pool only (no migration of mid-session) 3) run longseq harness + kernel patch in eu-canary 4) update changelog & comms if extended. agree?
priya: +1 on regional only. global rollback too disruptive.
mike: i'll prepare a 20% f32 pool pre-warm in APAC; ETA 25m.
eng-runtime: building a debug branch with synchronized eviction semaphore. will run longseq harness locally and push to ci-canary if green. ETA ~3h.
deploybot: Received TTL-extension request by sana. Verifying permissions...
deploybot: Pin TTL updated -> expires in 24h. pin_id=pin_4445560001. audit: user=sana.
ops-bot: noted in release-tracker: "2026-03-23 - regional soft-pin applied for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1; TTL extended to 24h; eng-runtime investigating kernel eviction race. PR placeholder: #7891"
product: drafting changelog line: "APAC: temporary routing to float fallback for quant-v5b to ensure correctness on long sequences. Region-specific soft-pin applied." will post draft for review.
sre-oncall: also adding an auto-unpin guard: deploybot will auto-unpin after TTL unless extended by owner. pager if unpin happens without triage note.
mike: prepping rollback playbook in case fallback fails: steps + runbook snippet attached.
priya: if eng-runtime confirms race and patch lands, we should test in eu-canary then lift APAC soft-pin. otherwise escalate to wider rollback.
sana: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source-of-truth. I'll update when ci-canary results or metrics change. please @mention in-thread for any urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
